claim: The Amazon MSK SLA guarantees a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% for Amazon MSK, including MSK Serverless and MSK Connect. You are eligible for an SLA credit if Multi-AZ deployments on Amazon MSK have a Monthly Uptime Percentage of less than 99.9% during a monthly billing cycle.

qualifiers.scope: Amazon MSK, including MSK Serverless and MSK Connect
qualifiers.condition: the SLA credit applies to Multi-AZ deployments; for provisioned clusters a Multi-AZ deployment is a topic with a replication factor of at least two and partition replicas in a different Availability Zone than the lead replica

evidence.quote: Our Amazon MSK SLA guarantees a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% for Amazon MSK (including MSK Serverless and MSK Connect).

For Amazon MSK provisioned clusters, an Apache Kafka topic with a replication factor of at least two, and the same Apache Kafka topic with partition replicas in a different AWS availability zone than the lead replica.
If Multi-AZ deployments on Amazon MSK have a Monthly Uptime Percentage of less than 99.9% during any monthly billing cycle, you are eligible for an SLA credit for Amazon MSK under the Amazon MSK SLA.
